user.title: LD2410 Tuner
user.description: Discover and tune all LD2410 devices automatically.

init.title: Recorded history location
init.description: Recorded history is kept in Home Assistant's storage folder unless you choose another folder here, such as a USB drive, an SD card or a network share mounted into Home Assistant (for example /media/usb or /share/nas). The tuner keeps its files in an ld2410_tuner folder inside it. Labels, settings and results stay in Home Assistant's storage. Saving reloads the integration; recording pauses while the history is copied.

data.move_history: Move the existing history to the new folder

data_description.history_location: An absolute path to a folder that already exists. Folders outside Home Assistant's configuration folder may not be included in Home Assistant backups.
data_description.move_history: Off: start a new history in that folder (or continue one already there) and leave the current files where they are.

error.not_absolute: Enter an absolute path, starting with /.
error.missing: That folder does not exist. Mount the drive or share first.
error.not_writable: Home Assistant cannot create, rename and remove files in that folder.
error.inside_storage: Choose a folder outside Home Assistant's .storage folder; leave the field empty to use the default.
